extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant issues, grant expected within 8 weeks
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a Cheltenham estate valued at £928,000 enquires about a £59,000 probate loan to pay inheritance tax before the grant is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the executors of the Cheltenham estate. We have noted the estate value of £928,000 and the £59,000 sought towards the inheritance tax liability. To take this further we would need a breakdown of the estate assets and liabilities, confirmation of the IHT figure and the relevant payment deadline, details of the property and any charges over it, the names of the executors and confirmation of your firm's instruction, plus identification documents. Once we have those materials a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
